basic_details.job_title: Calicut University Physiotherapist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Two Physiotherapist posts on a contractual basis are open at the Kannur Unit of the Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP), run by the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut. Applications on plain paper must reach the Director-CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 on or before 6 December 2026 (4 pm). The pay is a consolidated Rs. 26,400/- per month.

qualification.details: Essential qualification: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT). Desirable qualification: Master in Physiotherapy (MPT). Mode of appointment: Contract. Unit of posting: CDMRP Kannur Unit. Age limit: not specified in the notice. | For the full eligibility conditions of the post, candidates can refer to the official notification.

selection_process: All applications will be processed by the Director-CDMRP. The shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview before the selection committee. The notice does not give an interview date.

content_sections.heading: About CDMRP
content_sections.text: The Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP) is described in the notice as a joint project of the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut and the Social Justice Department, Govt. of Kerala. The programme is headed by the Director-CDMRP in the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut, Kerala. The two Physiotherapist vacancies are in the programme's Kannur Unit.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: There is no prescribed application form. The application is written on plain paper, giving full bio-data, and sent to this address: Director-CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 The application must reach this address on or before 6 December 2026 by 4 pm. The notice does not mention a particular postal mode or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT). Desirable qualification: Master in Physiotherapy (MPT). Mode of appointment: Contract. Unit of posting: CDMRP Kannur Unit. Age limit: not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, candidates can refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application on plain paper giving full bio-data Passport size attested photograph Attested copies of mark sheets Attested copies of certificates Other necessary documents

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications will be processed by the Director-CDMRP. The shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview before the selection committee. The notice does not give an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many Physiotherapist vacancies are there in Calicut University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 Physiotherapist vacancies, both in the CDMRP Kannur Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CDMRP Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Director-CDMRP on or before 6 December 2026 (4 pm).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT). A Master in Physiotherapy (MPT) is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the CDMRP Physiotherapist?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 26,400/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Calicut University Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: Send an application on plain paper with full bio-data, a passport size attested photograph and attested copies of mark sheets, certificates and other necessary documents to Director-CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: The Director-CDMRP will process all applications, and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview before the selection committee.

faq.question: Q7. Is the CDMRP Physiotherapist job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the Physiotherapist post is filled on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected Physiotherapists be posted?
faq.answer: The unit of posting is the CDMRP Kannur Unit.
